description: This file defines the interface and class declarations for MediaKeySession and its factory within the Rialto media server component. It includes class constructors, destructors, and method signatures related to media key session management, including license handling, decryption, and key management.

classes.name: MediaKeySessionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating MediaKeySession instances, implementing IMediaKeySessionFactory.

classes.name: MediaKeySession
classes.description: Implementation of IMediaKeySession and IOcdmSessionClient, managing media key sessions including license requests, decryption, and key management.

methods.name: MediaKeySession
methods.description: Constructor initializing a media key session with provided parameters.

methods.name: ~MediaKeySession
methods.description: Destructor for MediaKeySession.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Creates a license request with specified init data.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads an existing session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates the session with response data.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts encrypted media data.

methods.name: closeKeySession
methods.description: Closes the current key session.

methods.name: removeKeySession
methods.description: Removes the key session.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key is contained within the session.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets the DRM header data.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error code.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a specific key ID for the session.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if the key system is PlayReady.

methods.name: onProcessChallenge
methods.description: Handles processing of license challenge.

methods.name: onKeyUpdated
methods.description: Handles key update events.

methods.name: onAllKeysUpdated
methods.description: Handles event when all keys are updated.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles error messages.

methods.name: getChallenge
methods.description: Posts a challenge request to the main thread.

methods.name: initOcdmErrorChecking
methods.description: Initializes error checking for OCDM errors.

methods.name: checkForOcdmErrors
methods.description: Checks if an OCDM error has occurred.
